goal: Introduce the Interaction protocol (InteractionRequest, InteractionChannel post/poll/withdraw) and move clarify questions, /approve plan approval, Lane decisions and escalations onto its github channel, which applies only the literal-user answers ADR 0039 Decisions 9 and 12 grant and posts every other literal-user operation as notice only, per D3 of docs/specs/loop-agent-scheduling.spec.md.

acceptance.assertion: Source BR-DEC-6; meet D3 in docs/specs/loop-agent-scheduling.spec.md. Agreed seam: tests/loop-sched-interaction-github.test.ts and tests/loop-daemon-decisions.test.ts with a fake GitHub port. Done looks like: each interaction_id produces exactly one marker comment and a repost returns already_posted; a request whose binding (plan_digest, record_revision or issue_revision) changed is reported stale and its comment edited to a withdrawn notice. Bound: a Lane decision or /approve marker posted in the pre-protocol format is still parsed.

Source BR-DEC-8, BR-DEC-10, BR-SCN-3; meet D3 github.accepts in docs/specs/loop-agent-scheduling.spec.md. Agreed seam: tests/loop-sched-interaction-github.test.ts. Done looks like: /approve <digest> and a Lane decision reply are applied with today's checks; a breaking Intent revision, stop and authorization request is posted as notice_only naming the local action, and a GitHub reply to it is not applied. Negative: replies from a non-allowlisted author, from the daemon identity, edited after creation, or carrying a different digest or record_revision are ignored.
